messages:
leah: flagging a concordance regression after the qbringup last night. pairwise agreement on longform golden pairs dropped from 0.94 -> 0.81 for the canary.

omar: ouch. which quant path? any kernel change?

leah: q6b-int4-packed + kernel micro-tiling. generation quality seems fine but the curation concordance check (pairwise majority) shows systematic flips for de-id instruction variants.

tia: do we have a minimal batch to repro?

leah: uploaded sample ids to temporary gist and attached run artifacts: gist.github.com/redwood/longform-concordance-1829. example id 9f2c4 shows two different redaction prompts in golden pairing, same doc, different buckets.

frank: likely routing/fingerprint drift again. I can run a quick scan comparing fingerprint->pair assignment between stable and new kernel over a 6h window.

label-ops: impact: annotators are getting paired items with inconsistent instruction text. throughput down ~20%, disagreement up on the longform cohort. Pausing new longform pair assignments until we stabilize.

omar: mitigation strategy proposal: 1) run concordance delta analysis on a fixed micro-gold set (1k pairs) 2) if delta > 0.08, re-run dedupe with fallback fingerprint for dedupe-only pass 3) regenerate pairing manifest and hold label-ops assignment.

frank: I ran the micro-gold sweep locally: 1000 pairs, concordant pairs dropped from 940 -> 810; pattern concentrated on deid-heavy docs and long prompt margins.

tia: cheap fallback: rehash dedupe for affected candidates using fingerprint-v1 and keep q6b-int4 for generation. rehash window: 1828960000-1829000000.

omar: repro command I used:
```
python tools/compare_pairing.py --seedbank longform-canary --control-tokenizer stable --exp-tokenizer q6b-pack --out diffs/1829.csv
```
frank: and rehash/apply script:
```
python tools/rehash_and_manifest.py --seedbank longform-canary --window 1828960000-1829000000 --hash-version v1 --emit-manifest manifests/longform_concordance_fix_1829000000.json
```
Dry-run shows 164 affected candidates.

label-ops: please include original_instruction_id + pairing_source in manifest. We'll pause auto-assign and run manual checks on the manifest.

leah: running with --apply in 2m, @frank please monitor the pairing delta and post a 200-sample golden rescore.

frank: will do. also adding an eval: compute pairwise majority concordance and token-level redaction diff stats pre/post.

eval-bot: job:start concordance-rescore-1829000000 -> queued

frank: rehash applied, manifest produced at manifests/longform_concordance_fix_1829000000.json. 164 candidates moved, 52 reassigned to label-ops pool.

label-ops: manifest received. holding assignments and running small manual QA.

eval-bot: concordance-rescore-1829000000 -> complete. results: 200-sample rescore = 174/200 majority agreement (baseline pre-regression 188/200). improvement vs broken run (152/200).

leah: good recovery. plan: 1) resume longform pairing with fallback flag enabled for next 24h 2) add concordance gate to qbringup checklist (fail if micro-gold delta > 0.06) 3) schedule embed-dedupe prototype for long prompts as follow-up.

marc: (ops) created tickets INF-3899 (concordance gate), INF-3900 (rehash-fallback-job), INF-3901 (embed-dedupe-prototype).

label-ops: unpause approved. we'll monitor annotator disagreement telemetry for the next 2 shifts.

leah: closing thread: ingest resumed with fallback, manifest posted, concordance rescore artifacts uploaded to runboard. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
